author: copilot
subject: Implemented Parts F, A, C and D; Part B remains deferred
body: Implemented the approved listing sequence except the deliberately deferred encoded-range skip. Part F: runtime and v5.1 evidence now split `entriesConsidered`, `entriesValidated`, and `entriesReturned`; `requestsPerEntryValidated` is the blocking exact 4.0 invariant, validation concurrency is retained, and legacy live-v5 `entriesScanned` evidence remains readable without reinterpretation. Part A: hierarchical listing decodes catalog keys before backend validation and skips descendants only after a prefix has been established by a fully validated entry; internal names are also rejected before validation. Part C: flat catalog entries are validated with configurable bounded concurrency (default 32), buffered and emitted in catalog-key order; fan-out is capped by remaining output capacity (with one ordered probe only when needed to preserve existing has-more semantics), earliest-key backend errors are preserved, and continuation state is not advanced past unemitted work. Part D: per-container validation/authorization work uses the same ordered bound, while authorization still runs per container and concurrently across every backend. Added exact local tests for hierarchical considered/validated counts, four reads per validation, ordered concurrent errors, continuation, and per-backend authorization. Part B remains deferred pending measurement of these changes.
